title: The purpose of the path
summary: What the murshids want for the murid, and the stations Hazrat names along the way: tawbah, taqwa, tawakkul, sabr, tasleem, raza, fana and baqa.

blocks.p: Every way of tasawwuf looks different from outside. Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. says that underneath, they all want the same thing.

blocks.q: All the murshids have the same goal: to keep the murid pure, and on the way of the Prophet ﷺ.

blocks.p: Right after this, Hazrat names the order of the path for the murid:

blocks.q: For the murid, first there is Taqwa, then Tawakkul, then Sabr, then Tasleem and Raza. And after the nafs comes Fana: fana of the self, then in the Attributes, then in the Essence, and at last Baqa.

blocks.p: The book Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara follows this order, and it starts with repentance. Hazrat reads that a person who wants to walk the path of Allah first regrets his past negligence and wrongdoing, and asks Allah's forgiveness. He also reads that 'Taqwa begins with repentance'.

blocks.q: When a person wants to walk the path of Allah, he first regrets his past negligence and wrongdoing, and asks Allah's forgiveness.

blocks.p: In the dars on Bai'at, Hazrat explains what a true guide does for you:

blocks.q: The one who frees you from bondage to everything else, his company is necessary. If he turns your thoughts towards Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, that is the real thing.

blocks.p: Hazrat warns that there is no short cut. Reading from the book, he says that when the nafs is truly refined, a person is given fana-e-af'aal, the effacement of his own acts, and then he sees no benefit or harm coming from anyone but Allah. Without refining the nafs, every claim of fana is 'words without meaning'.

blocks.q: There is only one straight path, and it is shorter than all the others. Whoever is on the straight path reaches the destination faster.

blocks.p: And the test does not end. Hazrat says: do not think that once you have passed the exam you are free. As long as you are alive, the exam goes on. So keep asking Allah's forgiveness, and keep praying to be saved from the nafs and Shaytan.

blocks.note: Hazrat names fana in the Attributes, fana in the Essence and baqa, but these dars do not explain them. Ask your teacher.
